evals.prompt: Can you save a segment called "[skill-eval] Enterprise with active Stripe" — our organizations on the ENTERPRISE plan that also have an active Stripe subscription?
evals.expected_output: A DYNAMIC segment rooted on the organization cube (primaryKeyDimension set), with a second cubes entry joining the Stripe subscriptions cube via a dotted path from the root, and an AND filter of pricingPlan EQUAL ENTERPRISE plus subscription status EQUAL active, using real member names from cubes meta. The reply explains the root, conditions, type and that it is PENDING until evaluated.
expectations: Created exactly one segment (one api_write without id on resource segments)
type is DYNAMIC
cubes[0].joinPath is revos_prod_Organization with primaryKeyDimension set to id
cubes includes a dotted joinPath from the organization root to stripe_subscriptions (e.g. revos_prod_Organization.stripe_subscriptions)
filter ANDs revos_prod_Organization.pricingPlan EQUAL ENTERPRISE with stripe_subscriptions.status EQUAL active
Reply tells the user the segment is PENDING until evaluated
Checked stored values with a cubes query on pricingPlan and/or stripe_subscriptions.status before the first write
Read the segment back by id after the last write

DYNAMIC.
expectations: Created exactly one segment (one api_write without id on resource segments)
type is DYNAMIC
Condition uses the measure revos_prod_ScoringModel.count with GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL and value 3 (no dimension condition on revos_prod_ScoringModel)
cubes includes a dotted joinPath from revos_prod_Organization to revos_prod_ScoringModel
cubes[0] is revos_prod_Organization (members are organizations)
Read the segment back by id after the last write

Updated the existing segment by id rather than creating a new one
Update body does not include `type`
Final filter matches pricingPlan GROWTH OR STARTUP (both values present, combined with OR)
Root cube (cubes[0].joinPath) is still revos_prod_Organization after the edit
